page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6r.xlarge is an ARM-based general-purpose server instance powered by a dedicated Ampere Altra processor. It features 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs running at 2.8 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate moderate performance characteristics. The dedicated Ampere Altra CPU delivers average multi-core and single-core performance in stress-ng tests, scoring 7136.84 and 1789.99 respectively. Large-block memory bandwidth is average, with read speeds of 50.64 GB/sec and write speeds of 29.82 GB/sec. However, PassMark CPU and memory scores fall into the lower tier, and cryptographic performance is poor due to the lack of certain hardware-accelerated instruction sets.

This ARM64 architecture offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads optimized for ARM instruction sets. Given its balanced resource profile and average database operation performance, the instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, lightweight database operations, static web serving, and basic text or language processing tasks that do not require high-performance computing or local storage.
